caption: A new account opens on a Trial expired window that blocks the work until a plan is chosen or the trial is extended by 5 days; Free is listed with 75 responses a quarter, and Basic and Starter show 0 euros in this window; the account menu is hidden.

Choosing Free first asks why you want to downgrade: the Downgrade to Free Plan button stays greyed out until a reason is ticked, with Extend trial by 5 days and Talk to support below; the account menu is hidden.

Home screen after the downgrade: Response collected 0/75, resetting on Feb 15 2027, which makes the free limit 75 responses a quarter; My First Survey is listed with 0 questions; the account menu is hidden.

Question type picker: Upload, Matrix, Bipolar Matrix, Rank Order, Group Rank, Constant Sum, Payment, Signature, Heatmap, Group Rating and Record Audio carry a crown, which marks a paid type; the account menu is hidden.
Home screen after one own response: Response collected 1/75, and My First Survey shows 1 response and a completion rate of 100.0%; the account menu is hidden.
Downloads panel under Results: CSV and XLSX files have no crown, the SPSS file has a crown, so it is paid; the single Anonymous response is listed on the left.

Checkout for Basic paying quarterly: Basic at 39 euros a month is charged as 117.00 euros up front, with a switch to yearly billing that saves 240.00 euros; the card form is empty and the saved card label and account menu are hidden.
Upgrade page with yearly billing: Basic at 19 euros a month for 2,500 responses a year and Starter at 39 euros for 15,000 a year; the account menu is hidden.
